shareCard.text: A Minneapolis math club. We work through papers, proofs, proof assistants and puzzles together, around a table in a coffee shop or a brewery. Dates on Meetup, a sign-up link on every date, and the discussion in the chat.

questions.ask: Do I need to bring or prepare anything?

evidence.text: There is no syllabus, no reading list to keep up with, and no current focus.
Nobody sets an agenda - people bring what they are curious about, and the conversation runs in the club's chat.
Nothing to prepare and nothing to read first.
Bring a question; you don't need a field.
Come and listen if you would rather; no subject is assumed, no background is required, and none of the threads the chat runs is a prerequisite for arriving.
